title: Secure Phone Payment Line — Final-Notice Paydown on the Patient Financial Account
content:
The final-notice paydown is the amount a patient pays by card during the final-notice period of the Patient Financial Account (account status precollection) so that the account returns to active. It is settled when the patient asks to pay the account out of its final-notice period.

## Rule

The final-notice paydown is not fixed until the account's most recent statement is dated no earlier than its most recent charge posting. Put the other way round: while a charge on the account carries a posting date later than the date of the account's most recent statement, the final-notice paydown is not yet fixed.

The final-notice paydown is posted as one entry against the open charge with the earliest date of service, whether or not the patient names that encounter's encounter number, and once it is posted the account returns to active and its final-notice date is cleared.

| Records on the handling date (hypothetical dates) | Paydown fixed? |
|---|---|
| most recent statement 12 June; most recent charge posted 3 June | yes |
| most recent statement 12 June; most recent charge posted 12 June | yes — no earlier than the posting |
| most recent statement 12 June; most recent charge posted 20 June | not yet |

## Tool: `pay_final_notice_balance_8381dcc2`

**Capability.** Pays, by the patient's own payment card on the secure phone payment line, an amount toward a financial account that is in its final-notice period, and returns that account to active standing. One call records one card payment of exactly the amount given, posted against the ledger charge named and dated today; the account's balance owed goes down by the amount paid, its status becomes active and its final-notice date is cleared. The patient hears the confirmation on the line and sees the payment and the active status on the account.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_final_notice_balance_8381dcc2` through `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it on the secure phone payment line with the values the agent passes.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | reference number of the patient's financial account, as the agent reads it from the financial account lookup and passes it to the patient | identifier |
| `applies_to_txn_id` | reference number of the ledger charge the payment is posted against, as the agent reads it from the account ledger lookup and passes it to the patient | identifier |
| `payment_amount_usd` | amount the patient pays by card | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `billing_txn_id` (reference number of the new payment entry), `billing_account_id` (the account paid), `applies_to_txn_id` (the charge the payment was posted against), the amount (USD paid, 2 decimals), `payment_method` (always card), the status (the account status now recorded, active), `txn_date` (payment date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_balance` (balance owed once the payment is posted, USD, 2 decimals). The presence of `billing_txn_id` means the payment was taken.
